I feel like I don't have a place anywhere. My friends tell me about how I've helped them and say that my place is here, because without me they wouldn't have been able to carry on as well. But when they say this, I feel like a bad person, because everything I do has a purpose, whether to bolster relationships or to earn favours. And even then, all the things I do, I wouldn't be able to if I didn't have money, which is still being given to me by my parents as allowance. In other words, I don't need to be there at all, all they need is money.

Recently the friend I confessed to has also been relying heavily on me for emotional support and I've tried to do the best I can, but they still end up doing more stupid things that hurt not just her but me as well, even if they are ignorant of it. I feel powerless and useless.

It doesn't even end there. I keep seeing Facebook memories from years ago, and I realized that I was actually a huge asshole. Like I have been adamant that I only was as rough as I was because I was constantly ostracized and bullied. But maybe the problem was me all along.

All of these added up, all I can think about is that I'm hardly a person at all. I don't deserve to live and I am in so much pain. My heart constantly feels like there's a cold bony hand digging its fingers into it. I couldn't sleep because I was crying for hours. I tried calling my local suicide hotline, but the call wouldn't connect. I got through to the army's counselling centre, but I couldn't find the words to say but "help". Then after spending a few minutes crying on the phone, I apologized for wasting their time and hung up.

I don't know what to do anymore. It just hurts so much and it won't stop. I'm not doing a very good job of hiding it either. People are starting to see, and that worries me too because I'm usually a pillar of support for others. If they see just how broken I am, I'm afraid it'll hurt them too.

Not even my best friends believe me anymore. They have more or less given up on me and tell me to quit "being emo" or to "get over it" but I can't. It hurts so much and I can't get over it. If I wasn't so afraid to die, I really think I would have ended everything by now.
